rationale: Chief Justice Roberts is best positioned to write a narrow, administrable Lugar-based attribution test keyed to objective indicia that an account is held out and used as an instrument of office, while emphasizing (per Halleck) that the platform is not a state actor. Alito is likely to dissent on administrability/chilling-effect grounds, with some chance of separate concurrences (especially Thomas or Gorsuch) to sharpen the limiting principle or originalist framing.
